name: Temperature type code qualifier
description: Code qualifying the type of a temperature.

values.name: Storage temperature
values.description: Storage temperature [6240] The temperature at which the cargo is to be kept while it is in storage.

values.name: Transport temperature
values.description: Transport temperature [6242] The temperature at which cargo is to be kept while it is under transport.

values.name: Cargo operating temperature
values.description: Cargo operating temperature The temperature at which cargo is to be kept during cargo handling.

values.name: Transport emergency temperature
values.description: Transport emergency temperature The temperature at which emergency procedures apply for the disposal of temperature-controlled goods.

values.name: Transport control temperature
values.description: Transport control temperature The maximum temperature at which certain products can be safely transported.

values.name: temperature at which a liquid begins to boil.
